world.h: Iran says ready for all scenarios as talks go on
world.b: "We are prepared for all scenarios," Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said, as Trump called the talks "fine" but said Iranian authorities were not "reliable".
world.title: Iran and US explore diplomacy amid rising threats of war

world.h: Israeli drone strike kills five Gaza police
world.b: An Israeli drone attack killed five Palestinian police officers in al-Mawasi, west of Khan Younis, on Sunday; at least eight Palestinians were killed across Gaza.
world.title: At least eight Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza

world.h: Iran awaits US response on Hormuz plan
world.b: Tehran says it is waiting for a US response to its latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Al Jazeera is following the Iran war live.
world.title: Iran says waiting for US response to latest plan to reopen Hormuz Strait

national.h: ICE officer to surrender in Houston car strike
national.b: Indicted on an aggravated assault charge, the officer plans to turn himself in Monday, his attorney said. The man he hit with his SUV on Oct. 10 broke his leg.
national.title: ICE agent charged with assault for hitting fleeing man with car in Houston will turn himself in, attorney says

national.h: Supreme Court weighs religious schools in Colorado pre-K
national.b: At issue is whether religious schools in the state's universal pre-K program may refuse children of gay and trans parents despite a state anti-discrimination law.
national.title: Supreme Court hears religious freedom case centered on universal pre-K program

national.h: Analysis: 40% of DOJ 'noncitizen' list not on CA rolls
national.b: UCLA data analysts examined 20,930 names DOJ wanted California to separate on Election Day and found thousands of U.S. citizens appear wrongly flagged.
national.title: Analysis: More than 40% of names on DOJ list of alleged noncitizens not on California's voter rolls

politics.h: Sullivan says Peltola 'still lying' on ballot
politics.b: Two days before Election Day, Sullivan said Peltola lied about her campaign's role in a second Sullivan appearing on the Alaska Senate ballot.
politics.title: Sullivan claims Peltola is 'still lying' about campaign's involvement in Alaska ballot controversy

politics.h: Trump reflects on rallies in final midterm stops
politics.b: In South Carolina, Trump told supporters 'you'll never see it happen again' while boosting Senate picks Darline Graham and Michael Whatley.
politics.title: Trump thanks supporters for the memories in final campaign stops for 2026 midterms

politics.h: Paxton and Talarico trade attacks in Texas Senate race
politics.b: Talarico cast Paxton, who beat Sen. John Cornyn in the GOP primary with Trump's help, as corrupt; Paxton painted Talarico as too liberal for Texas.
politics.title: Paxton and Talarico tussle for Texas Senate seat as Trump campaigns virtually

politics.h: Judge tosses Trump's WSJ suit over Epstein letter
politics.b: A Miami judge dismissed the suit with prejudice, ruling Trump did not prove the Journal acted with actual malice.
politics.title: Judge dismisses Trump suit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday letter

politics.h: Alaska calls DOJ bid to set aside ballots 'meritless'
politics.b: The state attorney general's office filed a scathing response as Judge Sharon Gleason weighs dismissing the suit seeking to halt certification of a possible Peltola win.
politics.title: Attorneys for Alaska say 'meritless' Trump demand to set aside Senate ballots 'not even possible'

politics.h: Virginia and D.C. sue over Trump's arch
politics.b: There are now three lawsuits seeking to halt the planned 250-foot monument near the bridge to Arlington National Cemetery; Judge Tanya Chutkan is weighing an order to pause it.

international.h: Israel faces weeks of coalition wrangling
international.b: Neither the bloc around Netanyahu nor the Jewish parties opposing him won a majority in the 120-seat Knesset, leaving no clear path to a new government.
international.title: Israel election: When will government be formed, who will lead it?

international.h: Thousands in Delhi demand election chief resign
international.b: Rahul Gandhi led Sunday's protest over voter list revisions that opposition parties say favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling party.
international.title: Thousands rally in New Delhi to demand India’s election chief resign

international.h: Qatar LNG carrier struck by 'unidentified objects'
international.b: The Qatari owner said its Al Mayeda was hit in the Gulf Friday evening; no crew were injured, no environmental damage was reported and the ship is in safe condition.

international.h: Yemeni forces seize positions in al-Jawf
international.b: The army said its 1st Emergency Brigade seized Houthi weapons depots and destroyed armoured vehicles, as fighting deepens the crisis in besieged Taiz.

international.h: Rubio says US did not help Bolsonaro flee Brazil
international.b: Flavio Bolsonaro, under investigation in Brazil for alleged corruption and money laundering, arrived in Miami after the State Department said his family would get US visas.

international.h: Bangladesh forms wage board as garment protests go on
international.b: Thousands of workers demanding higher wages kept protesting around Dhaka despite the announcement; police fired tear gas and sound grenades.

international.h: Israelis rally for Jewish-Arab coalition to oust Netanyahu
international.b: Thousands urged opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, who has ruled out a coalition with Arab parties, to make a deal after Tuesday's deadlocked election.

international.h: Polish president holds crisis talks in court standoff
international.b: President Karol Nawrocki convened urgent consultations citing a threat to internal security; Prime Minister Tusk's Civic Coalition stayed away.

international.h: Erdogan urges halt to Black Sea attacks
international.b: At a news conference with Zelenskyy in Istanbul, Erdogan said attacks on civilian vessels were unacceptable whoever carries them out.

international.h: Nigeria probes two suspected Ebola cases
international.b: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control said two suspected cases in the northeast have been isolated while contact tracing and lab testing are under way.

international.h: Thousands rally in Berlin as Gen Z protests spread
international.b: A mixed crowd gathered near the Brandenburg Gate in support of young protesters, as a wave of student demonstrations sweeps Europe.

international.h: London police arrest 139 at Palestine Action protest
international.b: Hundreds gathered outside the US embassy to oppose the group's ban under UK terrorism law, ahead of a Supreme Court appeal on Wednesday.

international.h: Israeli attacks kill at least four in Gaza
international.b: A teacher was killed in shelling of the Nuseirat refugee camp, and a man died of injuries from an earlier strike on a vehicle in Tel al-Hawa.

international.h: Syria weighs joining Mecca defence pact
international.b: Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani said talks are under way on Syria entering the pact signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan, which treats an attack on one as an attack on all.

international.h: Oleshky evacuees reach Ukraine via Belarus
international.b: Residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky arrived in Ukraine under a localized ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump, expected to last through Sunday evening.

international.h: Germany and France brace for Halloween protests
international.b: About 150,000 people have registered to protest Saturday in some 30 German cities, led by the 'GenZ regelt!' group; some stores boarded up windows.

business.h: FBI blames North Korea for $6.3bn Binance heist
business.b: The FBI attributed the theft to TraderTraitor, the group behind last year's $1.5bn Bybit hack, and urged crypto firms to block laundering transactions.

business.h: Oil giants' earnings soar again on Iran war
business.b: ExxonMobil earned $15.4 billion, Shell $10.8 billion and Chevron $9.9 billion as the war disrupted supply; Brent crude trades near $113 a barrel, up from about $70.

sports.h: Texas gets a B, Ole Miss an A- in Week 9 grades
sports.b: No. 3 Georgia, No. 11 Texas and No. 12 Ole Miss cruised, while No. 1 Miami and No. 4 Indiana squeaked out close wins over unranked foes.
sports.title: College football grades: Texas earns 'B' mark for win, Ole Miss gets 'A-' on Week 9 report card

sports.h: Bowl projections reshuffled after wild Week 9
sports.b: USC's upset of Ohio State, Miami's escape at North Carolina and Georgia's rout of Florida reshape projections ahead of Tuesday's first CFP Rankings.
sports.title: Bowl projections: Projecting all 47 games as parity reigns ahead of first CFP Rankings release

sports.h: Valkyries win WNBA title as Williams stars in Game 7
sports.b: Finals MVP Gabby Williams scored 30 points, 28 in the second half, with four blocks to lead Golden State to the championship.
The win puts Lincoln Riley's Trojans back in the College Football Playoff discussion, with games against Indiana and unbeaten UCLA still ahead.
Five AP Top 25 teams fell in the first two windows, three to unranked foes. No. 3 Georgia routed Florida, while No. 25 Wisconsin's season slid to a halt.

sports.h: Police records: three more women accused Jacobs
sports.b: Records released to NBC 26 show three other women accused the Packers RB of abuse after his May arrest on domestic abuse charges; he has denied the allegations.

sports.h: Colts in Jonathan Taylor trade talks
sports.b: Indianapolis (2-5), which already dealt Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner this week, has received at least one offer including a second-round pick, per ESPN. Taylor says he hasn't requested a trade.
sports.title: Colts actively engaged in Jonathan Taylor trade talks: Five teams reportedly interested in star running back

sports.h: Warriors rally past Lakers despite rookie's rough night
sports.b: Yaxel Lendeborg had six points and five turnovers against Luka Dončić and the Lakers, but Golden State came back to win in the NBA Cup group-stage opener.

sports.h: Reigning NHL MVP Kucherov requests a trade
sports.b: The two-time Hart Trophy winner, 33, is in the final year of a contract paying $9.5 million a season after a 44-goal, 86-assist MVP campaign.

sports.h: Jacobs says TD celebration was about gospel song
sports.b: Packers RB Josh Jacobs said his celebration against the Panthers, which some saw as mimicking handcuffs, referenced the gospel song 'Break Every Chain.'

sports.h: Packers' Watson returns after hospital visit
sports.b: Christian Watson left with a chest injury, was taken to a hospital for precautionary tests, then returned after halftime against the Panthers with extra padding around his ribs.

goodnews.h: Maryland man grows oysters to revive the Chesapeake
goodnews.b: With oyster stocks plunged, a Kent Island resident raises them off his pier; his nets are packed with oysters after just three months of growth.

local.h: NYC Marathon kicks off under brisk skies
local.b: Runners set off from Staten Island Sunday morning in the high 40s as crowds cheered in Bay Ridge near the Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge.
local.title: Runners, and throngs of spectators, kick off the five-borough New York City Marathon

local.h: Visa granted for mom of slain Bronx teen, Mamdani says
local.b: Mayor Mamdani said Trump agreed to immediately grant a visa to the mother of Javits Frimpong, 15, who was shot and killed on his way to school.
local.title: Mamdani says Trump will 'immediately' grant visa to Ghanaian mom of slain Bronx teen

local.h: Jersey City pre-K busing hits crisis point
local.b: Overcrowding at P.S. 16 in booming Paulus Hook means its pre-K toddlers are bused across the city because the building has no room for them.
local.title: Overflowing school in downtown Jersey City is hitting a crisis point, parents say

local.h: Bronx e-bike fire death toll rises to four
local.b: Two teenage boys and a woman have died alongside Zion Maine after an e-bike battery ignited in the family's 11th-floor kitchen, blocking their exit.
local.title: Bronx e-bike fire that killed a boy has claimed 3 more lives, NYPD says

periods.name: This Afternoon
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 60. Southwest wind 6 to 8 mph.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 49. Southwest wind around 9 mph.

periods.name: Monday
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 66. Southwest wind 6 to 9 mph.

periods.name: Monday Night
periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a low around 52. Southwest wind 5 to 7 mph.

periods.name: Tuesday
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 68. Southwest wind 5 to 8 mph.

periods.name: Tuesday Night
periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a low around 56.

localgood.b: The Southern Taurids peak Nov. 4-5 with about five bright, slow meteors per hour, and Saturn and Jupiter are good viewing this month.
localgood.title: November has 3 meteor showers and the best chance to see Uranus

localgood.h: Formerly homeless New Yorkers lead outreach
localgood.b: Outreach worker Felipe Ramos, who cycled through homelessness himself, says his past is his superpower in getting people off Manhattan's streets.
localgood.title: How formerly homeless New Yorkers are helping others get off the streets

localgood.h: Hate crime survivor reclaims his marathon dream
localgood.b: A year after an attack cost him his first marathon, Daniel Cho will join more than 18,000 first-timers at this year's NYC Marathon.
localgood.title: A violent hate crime claimed one NYC man's marathon dream. A year later, he's taking it back.
